scope: Blog article drafts and their hero images only

content_agent.name: GPT-8 Marketing / ChatGPT Automation
responsibilities: Fetch this exact file from GitHub main before topic selection; validate contract_id/version and abort with a clear error if unavailable
Check recent published/draft articles and recent verified engineering changes
Create and read back exactly one draft with status=draft and published_at=null, regardless of image generation readiness
Use project xssiwlwlsyxrwdbninqe public.blog_posts; never assume project name identifies its purpose
Never claim draft/image success without readback
Do not call legacy paid image Edge Functions or reinterpret unsupported subjects as a generic frame

image_pipeline.name: GitHub Actions
responsibilities: Automatic image generation is disabled; owner creates and reviews images in ChatGPT on request

database.name: Supabase
responsibilities: Persist drafts, cover URLs and media metadata
Keep draft state and publication guard

publisher.name: User
responsibilities: Review and explicitly publish via blog dashboard

change_policy: Update this contract, the GPT-8 automation prompt and the GitHub contract-validation test together. Keep contract version pinned to supported major 1; fail closed on incompatible major.

image_engine.method: local authored SVG to real JPEG via @napi-rs/canvas
image_engine.selection: Full content evidence and explicit supported scene; generic AI/software keywords alone are insufficient
image_engine.unsupported_subject: Fail explicitly; request an authored scene extension, never substitute unrelated artwork
image_engine.visual_review: Inspect relevance, composition, mobile text, cropping and distinct art; build success and different hashes alone are not visual approval

workflow.publication: Draft-only automation; owner publishes manually from blog dashboard

shared_marketing_policy.requirement: Read from main before each run; apply relevant public SEO, social metadata, CTA and conversion rules; report missing implementation without claiming success; preserve independent workflow and publication approval gates

manual_creative_workflow.notification_content: Title, summary, dashboard draft link and draft status; full article remains in blog dashboard
